variants.headline: Party walks out of government
variants.body: The party {party} has walked out of the government. Give {target} a fair hearing; outrage alone should not be allowed to write the whole verdict.

variants.headline: A governing partnership breaks
variants.body: The government has lost the party {party} from its governing arrangement. Give {target} a fair hearing; outrage alone should not be allowed to write the whole verdict.

variants.headline: Departure redraws the question of cooperation
variants.body: The party {party} has left the colony's government. Give {target} a fair hearing; outrage alone should not be allowed to write the whole verdict.
